description: Displayed outside the Cold War Hangar. This airframe served as a CX-133 ejection-seat testbed with its rear seat replaced by a test mount, and has been returned to CT-133 Mk 3 standard. Arrived at the museum in September 2022; Skaarup's CT-133 list also still shows 133413 at Cold Lake, an unresolved duplication resolved here in favour of Calgary on the strength of the museum's own blog and the Calgary Herald.
aliases: CT133; T-33; T33; CX-133; CX133; Silver Star; 21413

description: Royal Canadian Navy Sea Fury, c/n 41H/636292, flown as VG-BC-K with 803 Squadron and photographed off Gibraltar in November 1950. Displayed outdoors at HMCS Tecumseh in 1977 before restoration and a move indoors to the Naval Museum of Alberta wing.
aliases: Sea Fury; Sea Fury FB11; FB.11

description: One of the last surviving Seafires. Delivered to the Fleet Air Arm at RDU Culham on 5 October 1945, acquired for the RCN in January 1946 and flown by 803 Squadron from HMCS Warrior. Previously marked TG-B, now marked VG. Naval Museum of Alberta wing.
